name: 草衣虫
evolution: 小草虫 → 草衣虫 Lv.20 → 花衣蝶 Lv.36
description: 与果树是互利共生关系，在果树之间采蜜的同时完成授粉。尾部的花朵是虹吸式进食器官，能够用来吸取和储存花粉，是访花昆虫中最重要的种群。
descriptionEn: In a mutualistic symbiosis with fruit trees, pollinating while collecting nectar among them. The flower at its tail is a siphoning feeding organ used to suck and store pollen, making it the most important population among flower-visiting insects.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, when responding to attacks.

skills.name: 虫茧
skills.description: 自己回复20%生命，己方队伍获得1次奉献：获得10%吸血。
skills.descriptionEn: Recovers 20% HP; ally team gains 1 Offering: gains 10% lifesteal.

skills.name: 啃咬
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，本技能会受奉献影响，每被影响1次，能耗永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; this skill is affected by Offering; each time affected, energy cost permanently +1.

skills.name: 飞叶
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 假寐

skills.descriptionEn: Recovers 2 energy; ally team gains 1 Offering: energy cost -2.

skills.name: 抓挠
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。

skills.name: 虫群智慧
skills.description: 己方队伍获得2次随机奉献。

skills.name: 虫结阵
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：己方队伍获得1次随机奉献。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; when responding to attacks: ally team gains 1 random Offering.

skills.name: 汲取
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage and drains 100% HP.

skills.name: 飞断
skills.description: 造成物伤，己方队伍获得1次奉献：威力+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; ally team gains 1 Offering: power +20.

skills.name: 花炮
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击自己获得魔攻+60%。
skills.descriptionEn: 2-hit combo; each combo gains Magic Attack +60%.

skills.name: 花香
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 芳香诱引
skills.description: 自己获得连击数+2，应对防御：额外造成打断，且敌方下回合获得眩晕。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains combo +2; when responding to defense: additionally causes interrupt and enemy is stunned next turn.

skills.name: 网缚
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得物防-30%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains Defense -30%.
